The '''''Coronet''''' was a luxurious [[Starship/Legends|spaceliner]] constructed by [[Kalevala Spaceworks/Legends|Kalevala Spaceworks]] as a testament to [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] engineering. Used as the personal starship of [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine]] of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]], the ''Coronet'' was the only ship of its kind, designed and furnished with the finest materials [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalorian space]] had to offer. Over two hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height, the ''Coronet'' was divided between stately cabins and elegant halls at its top, and utilitarian crew quarters and cargo holds in its long ventral spine. Despite the New Mandalorians' dedication to peace, the ''Coronet'' was equipped with both [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser]] and [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] for defense.

By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the ''Coronet'' saw significant use [[Transport/Legends|transporting]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] tourists to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], and officials in the New Mandalorian [[Ruling Council (New Mandalorians)/Legends|government]] as well as Mandalorian entrepreneurs took advantage of the starliner's journeys between Mandalorian space and the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] to import and export cargo. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Duchess Kryze utilized the ''Coronet'' on a trip to the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], to speak before the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. During this journey, however, the ''Coronet'' was [[Skirmish aboard the Coronet/Legends|attacked]] by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] aligned with the Mandalorian [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] splinter group, in an attempt to capture or [[Death/Legends|kill]] Kryze. Fortunately for the New Mandalorian leader, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]—along with a detachment of Republic [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]—were aboard, and managed to neutralize the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] attackers, saving Kryze and the ''Coronet'', which safely landed on Coruscant.

==Characteristics==
[[File:Coronet_docking_at_Coruscant.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The ''Coronet'' docking on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]]]
The vessel was built on [[Kalevala/Legends|Kalevala]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|home planet]] of the Duchess Satine. It was considered to be a flying palace, with the interior being ornately decorated. The ship carried many [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droids]], [[BD-3000 luxury droid/Legends|BD-3000 luxury droids]] and [[LEP servant droid/Legends|LEP servant droid]]. It had an interior cargo hold.

==History==
Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> the ship traveled to the planet of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] to transport [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Before the ship left, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tal Merrik/Legends|Tal Merrik]] had several boxes marked with the [[Senate]] seal smuggled on board. These boxes contained [[Assassin probe/Legends|assassin probes]]. During the [[Skirmish aboard the Coronet/Legends|trip]], the probes were released and unsuccessfully tried to kill the Duchess. Soon after, the vessel was attacked by three [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Droch-class boarding ship/Legends|''Droch''-class boarding ships]] that released [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] onto the ''Coronet''.<ref name="VoT" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Coronet'' first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] episode, "[[The Mandalore Plot]]," which aired [[January 29]], [[2010]]. The ''Coronet'' was the setting for the following episode "[[Voyage of Temptation]]," and appeared in a flashback at the start of the subsequent episode, "[[Duchess of Mandalore]]"—airing [[February 5]] and [[February 12]], 2010, respectively. Details and information on the ''Coronet'' were provided by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Jason Fry]] in the series reference books ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Episode Guide Series 1 & 2]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''.
